intent: Deepen F from 5 to 75 so it can absorb hour-length shortfall without becoming the hottest pool on the station. Ten of eleven M4 clocks are short before a song is drawn -- authored assuming ~3.5 min songs against a library averaging 3.2-3.6 -- leaving 55.6-58.4 min at the average draw and a 489 min/week deficit. That is ~144 F plays/week. At depth 5 F would run 4.1 plays/song/day, hotter than A1 at 4.54; at 75 it runs ~88h turnover and 0.27 plays/day. F is used rather than padding from gold or recurrents because it sits outside the depth solve: padding 144 plays/wk into G2010 (321 slots/wk) would be a 45% increase, cutting its turnover from 87h to ~60h and invalidating the drift and lock work. It also keeps filler VISIBLE in a log -- filler drawn from G1990 is indistinguishable from programmed gold, the same invisibility that hid M3's gold-heavy sound for an era. All picks are rock/alt genre, one per artist, no artist already in currents, 150-280s so they actually close a gap.
